hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ "${f##*/}" = "html_report.py" ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"Visual QA: html_report.py changed — screenshot before committing.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"UI source changed. Run uv run python -m bench.screenshot, Read the PNGs in results/shots/, and iterate until the design is right before committing."}}'; fi; }

IN=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) :;; *) exit 0;; esac; STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(bench/html_report\.py|results/report\.html)$'; then M=results/shots/.fresh; if [ ! -e "$M" ] || [ bench/html_report.py -nt "$M" ] || [ results/report.html -nt "$M" ]; then echo 'Visual QA stale: UI files staged but screenshots predate them. Run: uv run python -m bench.screenshot, Read the shots in results/shots/, iterate until satisfied, then commit.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
